question: If 40% of 50% of 1/2 of a number is 900. Find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages directly to their fractional equivalents for faster calculations.

40% = 2/5 and 50% = 1/2.

Net multiplying factor = 2/5 × 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/10.

So, 1/10 of the given number = 900.

Number = 900 × 10 = 9000.

**∴ The correct answer is 9000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40% of 50% of 1/2 of a number = 900

 x 
• 
 1/2 x/2 
• 
 50% x/4 
• 
 40% 900 Total effective fraction = 1/2 × 1/2 × 2/5 = 1/10 

**Calculations:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ 40% × 50% × 1/2 × x = 900

⇒ (40 ÷ 100) × (50 ÷ 100) × 1/2 × x = 900

⇒ (2/5) × (1/2) × 1/2 × x = 900

⇒ (2/20) × x = 900

⇒ 1/10 × x = 900

⇒ x = 900 × 10

⇒ x = 9000

**∴ The correct answer is 9000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage directly into a fraction, simply divide the value by 100 and simplify it. Knowing common fractions speeds up simplification significantly. For example: 40% = 40 ÷ 100 = 2/5 and 50% = 50 ÷ 100 = 1/2.

Successive Percentage Principle

When analyzing percentages connected by "of" successively (one after the other), their relative fractional equivalents are directly multiplied together to yield a net equivalent multiplying factor. Total factor = F₁ × F₂ × ... × Fₙ.
